steps.what: Establish restoration work packages, seasonal constraints, access, quantities and resource assumptions
Develop environmental restoration project schedules in {PROJECT} using native dependencies and resource conflicts
Develop restoration budgets from explicit quantities and approved cost rates in {SPREADSHEET}
Check the complete schedule and budget against ecological windows, contingencies, quantities and the intended project recipients
Save the checked schedule and budget package in {PROJECT}
Send the checked planning package to the internal restoration project team through {PROJECT}

tasks.design: Configure native dependencies in {PROJECT} and explicit quantity-times-rate formulas in {SPREADSHEET}. The planner retains ecological windows, resource assumptions and final package checking before separate save and internal send actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated dependency handling and cost arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native schedule checks and formulas can calculate explicit constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Seasonal uncertainty and feasible restoration sequencing.
tasks.human_edge: Ecological timing and realistic contingency judgement.

ambition.what: No additional project or spending authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less schedule and budget assembly, unchanged planning accountability.

reach.task: Explain restoration cost and timing risks

evidence.claim: Native dependency checks and explicit cost formulas can support restoration schedules and budgets while ecological assumptions remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is schedules and budgets, not ecological strategy design in 16875. The actual plan and its work quantities are inputs where already determined, without another design saving.

The planner supplies work packages, quantity, season and dependencies; resource owners supply actual availability and finance supplies approved rate, unit, currency and effective date. Missing availability or rates are manually checked in retained s2-s4 effort.

Native configuration first. Only dependency handling and arithmetic change; initial assumptions and final ecological check remain full. Normal final checking in s4 binds both completed artefacts and internal recipients. Ordinary save and send retain effort; shares are provisional.
unknowns: Current native dependency coverage and rate-table quality.
research_questions: Can schedule validation flag conflicts without assuming ecological windows are fixed?

already_counted.description: Ecological assumptions and final package review remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain schedule constraints and rate formulas.

approvals.approved_version: Exact schedule and budget checked in s4; edits void approval.
Exact package and internal recipient set checked in s4; edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 schedule and 14 budget points less 2 upkeep. Low is native checks and formulas already present or unavailable actual inputs.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide technical direction on restoration planning.

steps.what: Review actual restoration evidence and the planning questions raised by energy engineers, biologists, geologists or other professionals
Provide technical direction on environmental planning through actual discussion of restoration alternatives, interfaces and uncertainties
Write and check the actual direction and unresolved interfaces on the existing restoration work item {PROJECT}
Post the checked note to the assigned internal restoration work item {PROJECT}

tasks.design: Keep cross-disciplinary technical direction human and record its actual content on the existing {PROJECT} work item. Native project fields already hold identity; a new generator does not establish a reduction in the specific technical reasoning or note.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on the actual scientific interfaces and unresolved questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing work items already support recording the direction.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling disciplinary assumptions and practical restoration limits.
tasks.human_edge: Technical judgement and explaining uncertainty across disciplines.

ambition.what: No new technical approval authority is assumed.

evidence.claim: Project work items can record direction, but cross-disciplinary scientific advice depends on human interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary includes source review, actual direction and its existing written note, split out before zero. Creating the restoration plan itself belongs to 16875, not another hidden step here.
Professionals supply actual questions, evidence and proposed strategies; the planner supplies direction and uncertainties in s2-s3. Missing evidence requires human clarification within retained work.

Native work-item fields are already present and no repeated transfer is established. The technical note retains full writing time; no new approval ceremony is added. Normal author check binds the exact posted note and assigned work item. No system change means zero upkeep.
unknowns: Frequency and form of actual written direction.
research_questions: Is there any real repeated record transfer beyond native work-item fields?

already_counted.description: Review, direct advice and technical note writing remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact technical direction note and work item checked in s3; edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual reading, direction, note writing and posting remain; native record fields already cover the ordinary administration.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create habitat management or restoration plans.

steps.what: Evaluate actual habitat conditions, native tree establishment, weed pressure and management objectives
Choose native tree restoration or weed-control strategies, treatment limits and monitoring criteria
Create mapped treatment areas and explicit area summaries in geographic planning software {OTHER}
Write and check the complete habitat management or restoration plan, linking actual mapped areas and retaining ecological limits
Save the checked habitat plan in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Configure native geometry and area summaries in geographic planning software {OTHER}, with mapped-area references in {DOCS}. The planner chooses ecological strategies and writes the substantive plan; no model selects species, treatments or permitted interventions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Mapped areas and plan references can require repeated arrangement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native geographic tools calculate explicit geometry and reuse map outputs.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing ecological recovery, weed control and unintended harm.
tasks.human_edge: Ecological strategy and local habitat knowledge.

ambition.what: No extra treatment programme is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less map assembly, unchanged restoration decisions.

reach.task: Explain treatment boundaries and monitoring criteria

evidence.claim: Native geographic tools can calculate explicit treatment areas, while ecological strategy and plan meaning remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is ecological plan creation, not site assessment in 16876 or project schedules and budgets in 16856. Existing assessment evidence is input; its capture is not credited twice.

Survey or field records supply site ID, coordinate system, verified geometry, actual habitat observation and date. The planner supplies treatment boundary and strategy in s2-s3. Missing geometry or observation is checked manually; no aerial classification is accepted as ground truth.

Native geometry first. Only map assembly, area arithmetic and repeated plan references change; strategy selection and final ecological check remain. Normal author checking in s4 binds the completed plan. No external publication is hidden in save.
unknowns: Quality of existing habitat geometry and native area tools.
research_questions: Can configured map summaries prevent stale treatment areas in the written plan?

already_counted.description: Habitat assessment reading and ecological strategy remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain geographic layers and plan-reference fields.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final habitat plan checked in s4; changes require recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 7.5 map-assembly plus 1.4 reference-entry points less 1.5 upkeep. Low is existing map reuse or inadequate site geometry; no ecological strategy saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess sites for habitat certification or restoration needs.

steps.what: Read the habitat assessment criteria, actual site history and scope of any requested certification
Conduct site assessments through actual habitat inspection, observation capture and professional judgement on environmental damage, restoration needs or certification criteria
Complete and check the site assessment record or authorized certificate in {DOCS}, preserving actual findings, criteria, limits and recipient
Sign and save the checked site assessment output in the controlled record {DOCS}
Issue the checked signed assessment output to the designated external requester through {EMAIL}

tasks.design: Configure the existing assessment form in {DOCS} to reuse site identity and criteria headings. The planner performs the full site assessment and decides findings, then checks the complete output before separate signing/save and issue actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assessment outputs can repeat site and criteria identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse identity without deciding habitat condition.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing damage and restoration need from actual conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Field judgement and accountable certification where authorized.

ambition.what: No new certification authority or remote assessment is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated output setup, unchanged field responsibility.

evidence.claim: Native assessment forms can reuse site identifiers, but actual habitat assessment and certification conclusions remain professional judgement.

assumptions: Boundary includes the site assessment and its actual output and routine delivery. Certification is performed only where this professional already has authority; the tool does not grant it. No extra ecological strategy design is credited here.

Site administration supplies site ID, boundary and history; criteria owner supplies authorized revision. The planner supplies actual observation, location, date, evidence and conclusion in s2, fully counted. Missing evidence requires manual checking or another actual visit, not inference from a planned inspection.

Native forms first. Savings cover headers only; all fieldwork, evidence capture and substantive findings remain. Normal completed-output check in s3 binds exact content and requester. Any edit voids both gates; ordinary sign/save and issue retain full effort.
unknowns: Actual certification scheme and current form setup.
research_questions: Can identity reuse reduce entry without suggesting unearned certification?

already_counted.description: Criteria reading and actual site assessment remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final assessment output checked in s3; edits void approval.
Exact assessment output and requester recipient checked in s3; edits void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10% less header work in the 18-share output step saves 1.8 points less 0.4 upkeep. Low is forms already linked; no fieldwork, conclusion or issue saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use explicit planning tools while retaining ecological direction and site judgement.
reach: Explain restoration evidence and seasonal constraints to project controllers and habitat technicians.
role.ambitious_version: A planner whose schedules, habitat choices and assessments remain tied to actual site evidence.
